heard: Uranus has the coldest atmosphere of any planet. Its atmospheric temperature plunges to minus 371 degrees Fahrenheit. It holds that record despite being only seventh from the Sun. Methane gas absorbs red light, turning this freezing world blue-green. An Earth-sized object likely smashed Uranus sideways long ago. Its extreme tilt subjects the poles to decades of continuous darkness. Voyager 2 discovered another bizarre planet's secret during its 1986 flyby. Its magnetic center is offset by one third of the planet's radius, yet no other world in our solar system freezes quite like this.
